sentences.text: ↵:::tip{title="What is Everything as Code?"}↵Everything as code is a paradigm that treats any aspect of software development, delivery, or operation as a code artifact that can be versioned, tested, and deployed using the same tools and processes as the application code.↵In the era of cloud computing, automation, and DevSecOps, the concept of "everything as code" or simply "as code" has become increasingly popular and relevant.
